emails.title: Kick-off Email 1
emails.subject: Kick-off Email
emails.body:
Hi,

I am the consultant managing the <<AssessmentType>> assessment that has been scheduled with you. I am just sending a quick email to let you know that testing for this project has begun.

If I have any issues or require additional information, I will reach out. If you have any questions during the engagement, please feel free to contact me directly.

Many Thanks,

emails.title: Wrap-up Email 1
emails.subject: Wrap-up Email - No high or crit
emails.body:
Hi,

I am writing to confirm that the <<AssessmentType>> assessment have been completed.

No critical issues requiring immediate attention were identified. However, some lower-severity findings were noted and will be detailed in the final report. This report will be shared with you once our internal quality assurance process is complete.

Thank you for your assistance throughout the assessment.

Many Thanks,
